caption: These are the nine jobs a Leadlens agent can take off your plate: missed calls, slow DMs, booking, no-shows, review requests, quote follow-ups, common questions, after-hours enquiries and bringing back lapsed customers. You don't need all nine. Which one would you hand over first?

slides.headline: Nine jobs your phone could be doing.
Missed calls and slow DMs.
slides.body: Someone reaches out while you're busy. An agent replies so they don't go elsewhere.

slides.headline: Booking and no-shows.
slides.body: An agent books the time and reminds people, so the day runs to plan.

slides.headline: Review requests and quote follow-ups.
slides.body: After the job, it asks for a review. After a quote, it checks in.

slides.headline: Common questions and after-hours enquiries.
slides.body: Hours, location, what you offer. Answered at 9pm, not tomorrow.

slides.headline: And bringing back lapsed customers.
slides.body: A friendly nudge to people who haven't booked in a while.

slides.headline: You don't need all nine.
slides.body: Pick the one eating your week. Start there.
